source.author: lucr
source.text: ipse Epicurus obit decurso lumine vitae, qui genus humanum ingenio superavit et omnis restinxit stellas exortus ut aetherius sol.
source.text_original: ipse Epicurus obit decurso lumine vitae, / qui genus humanum ingenio superavit et omnis / restinxit stellas exortus ut aetherius sol.
source.text_english: Epicurus himself dies, his life’s light run through, he who surpassed the human race in genius and extinguished all the stars as they rose, like the heavenly sun.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: hic est ille, qui genus humanum ingenio superauit et omnes restinxit, stellas exortus ut aetherius sol.
reuse.text_original: hic est ille, qui genus humanum ingenio superauit et omnes restinxit, stellas exortus ut aetherius sol.
reuse.text_english: This is the one who surpassed the human race in genius and extinguished them all, rising like the heavenly sun, the stars.
